question: Which statement correctly identifies the property of matter that acts as the source of electrostatic interaction and fixes the sign and magnitude of the electric force?

options.A: Mass — it determines electric force between bodies.
options.B: Electric charge — an intrinsic property whose sign and amount decide the direction and strength of the electric force.
options.C: Density — higher density implies stronger electric force.
options.D: Inertia — resistance to change in motion causes electric force.
